verdict.rationale: Sift exposes REST APIs an agent could call to read per-user risk scores (Score API) and push business decisions (Decisions API). It also has a Workflows rules-automation platform, a Workflows API overview page, and Review Queues for human review. However, nothing in the evidence shows that rules or lists can be created or edited through the API, or that approval gates exist for such changes. Missing for 10: programmatic creation and editing of velocity rules, blocklist and allowlist management via API, an account-level fraud-posture read endpoint, human approval gates for agent-proposed rule changes, agent or MCP-oriented tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
